questions.question: The SI unit of force is:
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N).

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: The unit of electrical resistance is the:
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms.

questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: The Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) was led by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
questions.explanation: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930.

questions.question: The deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C.

questions.question: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:
questions.explanation: The UK uses the Pound Sterling.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj?
questions.explanation: Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in 1875.

questions.question: The Sundarbans delta is formed by which rivers?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans is formed by the Ganga–Brahmaputra delta.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.question: Which is the largest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.

questions.question: The currency of the United States is the:
questions.explanation: The US currency is the Dollar.

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: The gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is mainly:
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the main greenhouse gas.

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: The minimum age to become the President of India is:
questions.explanation: A presidential candidate must be at least 35 years old.

questions.question: The "Right to Education" was made a fundamental right by which amendment?
questions.explanation: The 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A — Right to Education.

questions.question: The powerhouse of the cell is the:
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce energy (ATP), so they are the cell’s powerhouse.

questions.question: The Simon Commission came to India in:
questions.explanation: The Simon Commission arrived in 1928 and was widely boycotted.

questions.explanation: Total parts = 12. Each part = 120/12 = 10. Larger = 7 × 10 = 70.

questions.question: A train 180 m long crosses a pole in 9 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 12 days and B in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/24 = 36/288. Time = 288/36 = 8 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √1296.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹720. Find its marked price.
Find 20% of 20% of 2000.
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 8 and their difference is 15. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 5 parts = 15, so each part = 3. Smaller = 3 × 3 = 9.

questions.question: A boat travels 68 km downstream in 4 hours. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 68/4 = 17 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 17 − 4 = 13 km/h.

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 53 days?
questions.explanation: 53 mod 7 = 4; Wednesday + 4 = Sunday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 12th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 12th letter = L; 12 + 2 = 14th letter = N.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (9, 733), (5, 125), (2, 8), (6, 216)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 9³ = 729, not 733.

questions.question: In a row of 58 students, Ravi is 40th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 58 − 40 + 1 = 19.

questions.question: Find the next term: 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 5²…9². Next is 10² = 100.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 10, 17, 26, 37, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 13, so 37 + 13 = 50.

questions.question: If STAR is coded as WXEV, how is FISH coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to FISH gives JMWL.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.
The relation is squaring: 9² = 81, so 10² = 100.

questions.question: A person walks 12 km East and then 16 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(12² + 16²) = √400 = 20 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 8 + 4 × 6.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 8 × 4 − 6 = 32 − 6 = 26.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 6, 18, 54, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3: 54 × 3 = 162.

questions.question: Complete the series: F, H, J, L, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 2 places, so the next is N.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 25, 5, 3, 17
questions.explanation: 5, 17, 3 are prime numbers; 25 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 8th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 8th letter from the right is the 19th from the left = S.
